sources.summary: Casa Cieno is located on a 1,500 m² lot in the El Vigía sector of Puerto Escondido , on the coast of Oaxaca. The project was conceived under the premise of blending into the site to become part of the landscape rather than imposing itself on the environment. Since it is not located directly on the beachfront, the architecture focuses on inward-facing living, giving equal importance to the experience of the interior spaces and their relationship with the surrounding context.
